simulator.note: Boots as the M3329 family (chips/m3329.py): M3329.default_chip_id() selects 0x3101 (M3329C / M3101C; 0x3329 hits sdbbp in the bootloader's chip-ID check at 0xAFC0122C) and M3329._uses_spi_flash() detects the bootloader's SF_INS / SF_FMT stores at 0xB8000098..99, leaving parallel NOR disconnected so the native SPI flash controller serves its 2 MB flash.  The bootloader prints "BL: APP  init ok" on UART 0xB8001300, unpacks the 2.7 MB LZMA maincode V1.2.62C to RAM and starts it ("MC:APP  init ok", "APP init finished...").  The application drives its 4-digit panel on GPIO 30 (SCL) / 31 (SDA) through " on " -> "----" -> "OOO1", draws the channel 0001 banner ("$Pershiy Nacionaln") and "Немає сигналу!" dialog via OSD_M3327C, and responds to remote navigation (0x0101 Libcore key table in RAM with customer code 0x02370000 off $gp: MENU opens the 3D-icon main menu, DOWN steps to "Інсталяція").

desc: 2 MB SPI flash dump (firmware V1.2.62C) from an Opticum X80 Premium compact DVB-S satellite receiver (Etek ETK01 M3329C_DVBS mainboard).

Unlike earlier 2005 M3329 boards with 8-bit parallel NOR flash and XIP maincode, this later M3329C / M3101C generation boots from a 2 MB SPI flash via SF_INS / SF_FMT (0xB8000098) and unpacks an LZMA-compressed Libcore 1.3.4 application into SDRAM.
